name: Industrial water-tube package boiler
description: Shop-assembled watertube boiler (steam and lower drum above a water-cooled membrane furnace) custom-engineered per project, with D-type and O-type two-drum layouts. The standard steam generator above the fire-tube class for refineries, petrochemical plants and industrial power, firing liquid or gaseous fuels including refinery byproduct gases.

subtypes.name: D-type
subtypes.description: one steam drum and one lower drum centered over each other with the furnace offset to one side, one generating bank

subtypes.name: O-type
subtypes.description: drums centered over each other with the furnace in the center of the boiler, two generating banks

subtypes.name: Elevated drum
subtypes.description: upper steam drum shipped separately and installed on site, for drum retention times of 5 minutes or more and shipping-limited loads

applications: carbon black, composite and carbon fiber, wood products

specifications.basis: 4.5 to 544.2 T/h depending on type and design features
